Brief: Tell me about the Hubble Space Telescope and what it has discovered. — about Key projects

Kept:
1. In the early 1980s, NASA and STScI convened four panels to discuss key projects.
2. These were projects that were both scientifically important and would require significant telescope time, which would be explicitly dedicated to each project.
3. The panels identified three such projects: 1) a study of the nearby intergalactic medium using quasar absorption lines to determine the properties of the intergalactic medium and the gaseous content of galaxies and groups of galaxies; 2) a medium deep survey using the Wide Field Camera to take data whenever one of the other instruments was being used and 3) a project to determine the Hubble constant within ten percent by reducing the errors, both external and internal, in the calibration of the distance scale.
